panels.title: 선택한 보고서의 고정된 데이터 · 화면 시간 범위와 무관

targets.rawSql: SELECT period_end::text AS 보고일, assessment_mode AS 평가출처, generated_at AS 생성시각, ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - period_end) AS 보고일경과일수, completeness_scope AS 수집범위, gold_run_id, rule_version, report_id FROM reporting.v_report_index WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring} AND household_id=${household:sqlstring}

WITH rolling AS (
SELECT *, avg(usage_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY usage_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg7,
count(usage_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY usage_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS samples7
FROM reporting.v_appliance_daily WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring} AND household_id=${household:sqlstring} AND appliance_type=${appliance:sqlstring}
) SELECT CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM usage_date) = 1 THEN to_char(usage_date, 'MM-DD') ELSE repeat(' ', extract(isodow FROM usage_date)::int) END AS date,
usage_minutes AS 사용분, CASE WHEN samples7=7 THEN avg7 END AS "7일 평균 (7일 유효 시)"
FROM rolling WHERE true  AND usage_date > (SELECT period_end FROM reporting.report_runs WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring}) - (CASE ${days:sqlstring} WHEN '7' THEN 7 WHEN '90' THEN 90 ELSE 30 END) ORDER BY usage_date

SELECT CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM usage_date) = 1 THEN to_char(usage_date, 'MM-DD') ELSE repeat(' ', extract(isodow FROM usage_date)::int) END AS date, max_valid_score AS "VALID 최대점수", max_partial_score AS "PARTIAL 최대점수" FROM reporting.v_household_daily WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring} AND household_id=${household:sqlstring} AND usage_date > (SELECT period_end FROM reporting.report_runs WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring}) - (CASE ${days:sqlstring} WHEN '7' THEN 7 WHEN '90' THEN 90 ELSE 30 END) ORDER BY usage_date

SELECT CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM usage_date) = 1 THEN to_char(usage_date, 'MM-DD') ELSE repeat(' ', extract(isodow FROM usage_date)::int) END AS date, recorded_count AS "저장 평가건수", valid_count AS "VALID 건수", partial_count AS "PARTIAL 건수" FROM reporting.v_household_daily WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring} AND household_id=${household:sqlstring} AND usage_date > (SELECT period_end FROM reporting.report_runs WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring}) - (CASE ${days:sqlstring} WHEN '7' THEN 7 WHEN '90' THEN 90 ELSE 30 END) ORDER BY usage_date

panels.title: 일별 사용 품질 · UNKNOWN/MISSING은 사용량 0이 아님

targets.rawSql: SELECT usage_date::text AS 날짜, usage_status AS 상태, usage_minutes AS 사용분, usage_count AS 시작횟수 FROM reporting.v_appliance_daily WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring} AND household_id=${household:sqlstring} AND appliance_type=${appliance:sqlstring}  AND usage_date > (SELECT period_end FROM reporting.report_runs WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring}) - (CASE ${days:sqlstring} WHEN '7' THEN 7 WHEN '90' THEN 90 ELSE 30 END) ORDER BY usage_date DESC
